exposure: intrauterine growth status (appropriate for gestational age - AGA, small for gestational age - SGA)
outcome: neurodevelopmental outcomes (cerebral palsy - CP, developmental delay - DD) at 3 years of age
cohort: Singleton very low birth weight infants born at <32 weeks' gestation, registered in the Neonatal Research Network Japan database, whose outcomes were evaluated at 3 years of age.
finding: The mortality and neurodevelopmental outcomes of liveborn preterm VLBW infants born to mothers with HDP depended on their intrauterine growth status and gestational age at birth, with H-SGA infants having higher risks for adverse outcomes at younger gestational ages.
